notablePrerequisites: Opponents are unable to pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
easyPrerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
description:
Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {3}{U}, causing each player to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers for each opponent you have, creating at least six Treasure tokens due to Xorn.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
